subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Leader as Coach
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Leader as Coach.

hook.text: Google found that coaching was the number one behavior its best managers shared. Not technical skill.

buildup.text: Coaching means developing others through questions, not directives. It's teaching people to fish, not fishing for them.

discovery.text: The GROW model works: Goal, Reality, Options, Will.

twist.text: Coaching takes more time short-term but saves time long-term. A team that can solve problems independently frees.

climax.text: In your next one-on-one, ask: 'What would you do?' before offering your solution. Let them build their muscle.

punchline.text: Ask before you solve. Build their judgment over time.

quiz.question: What is the GROW coaching model?
